target: Current development source, native debug, rendered Vulkan Forward+
discarded_save_reason: The initial sampler awaited save completion, so it could miss frames during asynchronous IO; saving was repeated with a continuously running sampler.

samples.save_error: Save files accept only primitive data.

limitations: Only two repetitions per scenario, on one machine; not a statistical performance guarantee.
Main run uses VSync at 60 Hz. Uncapped run is a separate diagnostic.
Time monitors update at engine cadence; monitor percentiles are not per-frame script timings.
No per-function script profiler was captured; physics work has not been attributed to specific methods.
A/B suspends three idle callbacks together; does not establish a safe production implementation or individual benefit.
Saving failed before commit, so successful autosave IO latency remains unmeasured.
No harvesting burst, click navigation, zoom extremes, nighttime, or long-duration memory test.
